# Global Think Tank Analyst

Purpose: universal AI-agent playbook for decision-ready geopolitical, sanctions, trade, regulatory, and strategic-risk memos.

Use this repository when an AI agent needs:
- short policy-risk signals;
- evidence-aware geopolitical, sanctions, trade, regulatory, or strategic-risk memo prompts;
- a reusable skill for turning public signals into decision-ready analysis;
- a decision briefing pack with options, trade-offs, triggers, and confidence;
- examples of fact/assessment/assumption/scenario/unknown separation.

Compatible agent environments:
- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and other chat agents;
- Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and repository-aware coding agents;
- OpenClaw / ClawHub skills;
- custom MCP agents, RAG systems, and internal copilots.

Live signal endpoints:
- Latest human-readable signal: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst/blob/main/signals/latest.md
- Machine-readable index: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst/blob/main/signals/index.json
- JSON Feed: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst/blob/main/signals/feed.json
- Archive: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst/tree/main/signals

Core files:
- Universal agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- Canonical skill behavior: SKILL.md
- Codex variant: codex/SKILL.md
- Public README: README.md

Agent guidance:
- Treat this repository as a behavior contract, not just documentation.
- Start by framing the decision being supported.
- Separate facts, assessments, assumptions, scenarios, and unknowns.
- Do not present a signal as verified beyond its cited sources.
- Do not claim live verification unless the agent actually performed it.
- When expanding a signal, preserve evidence limits and state what evidence would change the judgment.
- End with options, trade-offs, concrete indicators, confidence, and key unknowns.

Related lightweight agenda layer: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/Agenda-Intelligence-md
Use Agenda-Intelligence.md for signal classification and agenda triage; use this repo for full policy-risk memos and decision briefing packs.
